<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914360_theRebbe_10" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914360_theRebbe_10__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the unity in the Four Species and the Sukkah is not merely a unification of separate things, but a true unity beyond division.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And the explanation of the matter</t>
    <t s="2">(the connection of taking the Four Species with the festival of Sukkot)</t>
    <t s="3">in a deeper way,</t>
    <t s="4">that the matter of unity in both of them is not only in a manner of unification of separate things,</t>
    <t s="5">but a true unity that is above division.</t>
    <t s="6">For in the mitzvah of taking the Four Species, in addition to the unity within each of the four species</t>
    <t s="7">(as it is by itself),</t>
    <t s="8">which is a unification of separate things,</t>
    <t s="9">nevertheless, all four species become one mitzvah,</t>
    <t s="10">one matter.</t>
    <t s="11">For although they are four different species,</t>
    <t s="12">and from one extreme to the other,</t>
    <t s="13">as it is brought in the Midrash</t>
    <t s="14">that the four species of the lulav correspond to four types among Israel,</t>
    <t s="15">from the type corresponding to the etrog, which has taste and smell</t>
    <t s="16">(Torah and good deeds)</t>
    <t s="17">until the type corresponding to the willow, which has neither taste nor smell,</t>
    <t s="18">nevertheless, they all become</t>
    <t s="19">(all four types)</t>
    <t s="20">one bundle to do Your will,</t>
    <t s="21">and this unity</t>
    <t s="22">(that they all become one bundle to do Your will)</t>
    <t s="23">is a true unity that is above division.</t>
    <t s="24">And likewise is the matter of the unity of the Sukkah,</t>
    <t s="25">that after it says "You shall dwell in booths for seven days,"</t>
    <t s="26">the matter of the unity of separate things</t>
    <t s="27">(that seven days are unified in one Sukkah),</t>
    <t s="28">it adds "all the native-born in Israel shall dwell in booths"</t>
    <t s="29">("shall dwell" without specification,</t>
    <t s="30">and it does not say "for seven days"),</t>
    <t s="31">a true unity that is above division.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the connection of Sukkot to the harvest, describing two levels of gathering: first of each type individually, then of all types together.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And based on this, the connection of the festival of Sukkot</t>
    <t s="2">("you shall celebrate the festival of Hashem for seven days,"</t>
    <t s="3">the mitzvah of dwelling in the Sukkah and the mitzvah of taking the Four Species)</t>
    <t s="4">to "when you gather in the produce of the land" will be understood,</t>
    <t s="5">for "when you gather in" is the matter of unity,</t>
    <t s="6">that initially they are separate things,</t>
    <t s="7">and the matter of "your gathering" is to gather them</t>
    <t s="8">(and unify them)</t>
    <t s="9">together.</t>
    <t s="10">And there are two matters in this</t>
    <t s="11">(paralleling the two levels of unity in the Sukkah and the Four Species).</t>
    <t s="12">For first is the gathering</t>
    <t s="13">(and unification)</t>
    <t s="14">of the multitude of details of each and every species</t>
    <t s="15">(grain,</t>
    <t s="16">wine and oil)</t>
    <t s="17">by itself,</t>
    <t s="18">and afterwards is the gathering</t>
    <t s="19">(the unification)</t>
    <t s="20">of all three species together,</t>
    <t s="21">that one gathers all of them into the house</t>
    <t s="22">(to one place).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section describes the service from Rosh Hashanah through Yom Kippur to Sukkot, emphasizing that after the abstraction of Yom Kippur, the unity must be drawn down into physical objects like the harvest, the Sukkah, and the Four Species.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, all these matters come after the service of the beginning of the month of Tishrei,</t>
    <t s="2">the letters of "reishit" (beginning).</t>
    <t s="3">For the ten days between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur,</t>
    <t s="4">ten days,</t>
    <t s="5">are a level of division,</t>
    <t s="6">and on Yom Kippur they are included and unified in one day</t>
    <t s="7">(of Yom Kippur),</t>
    <t s="8">"once a year,"</t>
    <t s="9">and after Yom Kippur,</t>
    <t s="10">in the four days between Yom Kippur and Sukkot,</t>
    <t s="11">is the preparation for the fulfillment of the mitzvot of "You shall dwell in booths" and taking the Four Species,</t>
    <t s="12">including also the service of "when you gather in your works from the field,"</t>
    <t s="13">for this service is</t>
    <t s="14">(as mentioned above at the beginning of the maamar)</t>
    <t s="15">before and a preparation for the festival of Sukkot.</t>
    <t s="16">However, on Yom Kippur,</t>
    <t s="17">on which there is no eating or drinking, etc.,</t>
    <t s="18">it is in a manner of abstraction from worldly matters.</t>
    <t s="19">And especially in the Neilah prayer of Yom Kippur,</t>
    <t s="20">when then Israel and the King are alone together.</t>
    <t s="21">For this is the explanation of "Neilah,"</t>
    <t s="22">that all the gates are locked and they are found</t>
    <t s="23">(inside)</t>
    <t s="24">only Israel and the King.</t>
    <t s="25">And in order to complete the intent of a dwelling place in the lower worlds,</t>
    <t s="26">there must be a drawing down</t>
    <t s="27">(to draw down the matter of unity)</t>
    <t s="28">below,</t>
    <t s="29">into this physical world,</t>
    <t s="30">even into the physical matters of this world,</t>
    <t s="31">beginning with "when you gather in your works from the field,"</t>
    <t s="32">for although it is a spiritual service</t>
    <t s="33">(as mentioned above at the beginning of the maamar),</t>
    <t s="34">nevertheless, it is also connected with the gathering of the produce</t>
    <t s="35">("your grain, your wine, and your oil")</t>
    <t s="36">in its simple physical sense,</t>
    <t s="37">and likewise is it also in the mitzvah of "You shall dwell in booths,"</t>
    <t s="38">that the roofing of the Sukkah must be from "your threshing floor and your winepress," and specifically from the waste of the threshing floor and winepress,</t>
    <t s="39">and likewise is it also in the mitzvah of taking the Four Species,</t>
    <t s="40">that one cannot fulfill the mitzvah through intention,</t>
    <t s="41">through the service of the emotions</t>
    <t s="42">(although the four species are from the category of vegetation, and vegetation is the matter of the emotions),</t>
    <t s="43">and also not through the service of Malchut</t>
    <t s="44">(even though the matter of the waving is to draw down into Nukva d'Z'eir Anpin</t>
    <t s="45">(Malchut)</t>
    <t s="46">which stands at the chest of Z'eir Anpin),</t>
    <t s="47">but one specifically needs physical four species,</t>
    <t s="48">and that they touch the chest</t>
    <t s="49">specifically the physical chest.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
